one notice for invalid curate operation from its reflect+curate calls
subsequent capture makes no additional model call or notice

semantics: Completed malformed JSON/envelopes and output-contract length violations checkpoint once with diagnostics; no automatic retry.
Invalid curator operations reject only their candidate, retaining valid siblings. Missing/duplicate operations reject that candidate. Diagnostics capped at 32 reasons, each 200 characters.
Network/provider errors and cancellation preserve pending evidence for retry. Original session evidence is not deleted or rewritten.
Standalone neighboring facts beginning Until or For the next do not qualify the preceding fact. Bare following expiry, direct anaphoric qualifiers, and bare preceding temporal headings still attach.
Literal validation matches complete Unicode tokens and numeric decimals, so source 300 cannot justify removing old 3.
After capture tracing, notify once using the first actual rejected-output reason; skip expected temporary-lifetime and already-documented rejections. No automatic retry was added.
Resumed and current results aggregate saved counts, require both skipped flags, and concatenate rejection diagnostics before the existing trace, notice, and maintenance handling.
At most one curator repair call per entire capture pass, only for edit-shape errors after authority/scope checks; candidate, action, and neighbor remain fixed and all guards revalidate.

Malformed repair output records a rejection, preserves original operations and valid siblings, and checkpoints invalid candidates without later paid retries. Transport/abort still retains pending evidence.
The capture live harness now tests retained pending state plus the actual unavailable-model failure, rather than an obsolete notice string.
limitations: Original failed capture-release and diagnostic probes remain preserved. Contaminated diagnostic is excluded from exact-fixture proof; labelled broad output is a deterministic test fixture.
Live proof covers one synthetic capture/correction/retry sequence; no broad memory-quality claim.
